Add "Custom models each designer has created in Firefly". Reword the publishing line to Adobe's condition, for example "On enterprise plans, each model published where the organization's workflow requires it before other apps can use it".
- **Gain:** title "Custom models on the Figma canvas". Text: "Your client's designers generate images in the style or subject of the custom models they have created, inside Figma, with the same models they use in Firefly, Adobe Express and Photoshop." The custom models overview page, already cited, backs the app list.

issues.title: One Figma plugin appears as two connections under three names
issues.fix:
Use Adobe's listed name, Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin, on both cards:
- GenStudio label: 'Adobe's Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin in Figma generates on-brand ad variations in Figma templates and exports them to GenStudio for Performance Marketing'.
- Start the Custom Models 'how it works' text with: 'In Adobe's Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin for Figma, the same plugin as on the GenStudio for Performance Marketing card, ...'.

issues.title: The 'how it works' texts read like user manuals and make these cards the longest in the catalog
issues.fix:
Use two or three sentences on what moves where, and keep formats and limits in the prerequisites. Every fact below is on the pages already cited.
- AEM Assets: 'Adobe's AEM Assets Connector opens as a panel in Figma. Designers search AEM Assets, place images, videos, GIFs and SVGs on the Figma canvas, bring in newer versions with Check for updates, and upload a selected item or a whole page to an AEM Assets folder.'
- Adobe Express: 'The Figma add-on in Adobe Express connects the user's Figma account and imports a page, frame or layer from a Figma file, as editable Express elements (Native Import) or a flattened image (Rasterize). Some gradients, patterns and masked shapes come in as images, and fonts Express lacks get a fallback. The Figma file is not changed.'
- GenStudio: 'Adobe's Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin adds a GenStudio for Performance Marketing panel to Figma. Designers map the text and image layers of their ad templates to GenStudio fields, generate up to eight on-brand Meta, LinkedIn or Display variations from a brand, persona, product and prompt, translate them, and export them to GenStudio for Performance Marketing as experiences.'
